Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed James Kirkwood’s death date by confusing James Kirkwood Sr. (the film director, died August 24, 1963) with James Kirkwood Jr. (the writer, died in 1989), even stating an incorrect 1989 date. This identity conflation introduced an erroneous basis for the comparison of which director died first.
